title: 헌법연구관 등의 근무성적평정 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:7:0:00008:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 7 (Retention of Appraisal Materials)
(1) An appraiser shall submit the relevant materials to the President of the Constitutional Court immediately after conducting a performance appraisal.
(2) The President of the Constitutional Court shall retain the performance appraisal materials.
